## Blog
- [Real\-Time Ad Optimization: How Custom Algorithms Boost ROI](https://env-newperion-premiumstg.kinsta.cloud/blog/real-time-ad-optimization-how-custom-algorithms-boost-roi/)
- [What is Digital Out\-of\-Home \(DOOH\) Advertising? Key Concepts and Examples](https://env-newperion-premiumstg.kinsta.cloud/blog/what-is-digital-out-of-home/): Digital Out\-of\-Home \(DOOH\) advertising is a dynamic evolution in out\-of\-home marketing\.
- [What Is Retail Media: A Guide With Basics and Benefits](https://env-newperion-premiumstg.kinsta.cloud/blog/what-is-retail-media-a-guide-with-basics-and-benefits/): Retail media ads are advertisements at or close to the point of sale, whether brick\-and\-mortar stores or e\-commerce websites\.
- [What is a Demand\-Side Platform \(DSP\): Definition and Features](https://env-newperion-premiumstg.kinsta.cloud/blog/what-is-a-demand-side-platform-dsp-definition-and-features/): Understand how DSPs streamline ad buying and optimize campaigns\.
- [What’s the Difference Between CTV and OTT Advertising?](https://env-newperion-premiumstg.kinsta.cloud/blog/whats-the-difference-between-ctv-and-ott-advertising/): Discover the key differences between CTV and OTT advertising, their features, benefits, and how to create impactful strategies for digital audience engagement
## Case Studies
- [Owl Labs Case Study: High impact ads](https://env-newperion-premiumstg.kinsta.cloud/case-studies/owl-labs-case-study/): High impact ads with cookieless targeting garners better performance compared to cookie based audiences
- [Stop \& Shop boosts in\-store visits \& key digital metrics](https://env-newperion-premiumstg.kinsta.cloud/case-studies/stopandshop-case-study/): Stop \& Shop boosts in\-store visits \& key digital metrics using cookieless SORT™ technology
- [Accor Case Study: maximizing engagement on Meta with Outmax](https://env-newperion-premiumstg.kinsta.cloud/case-studies/accor-case-study/): Smart Advertising, Real Impact: How Accor Reduced Emissions in Meta Campaigns with Perion
- [Mercedes Benz Case Study: increased awareness \& intent](https://env-newperion-premiumstg.kinsta.cloud/case-studies/mercedes-benz-case-study/): Mercedez\-Benz sees increased awareness \& intent when pairing unique high impact executions with privacy\-first SORT™ targeting\.
- [Colorado Tourism Case Study](https://env-newperion-premiumstg.kinsta.cloud/case-studies/colorado-tourism-case-study/): Tourism brand outperformed longstanding cookie\-based targeting approach using SORT™ technology
## Glossary
- [Category](https://env-newperion-premiumstg.kinsta.cloud/glossary/category/): Inventories of keywords and phrases associated with the content of webpages and apps\.
- [Behavioral Targeting](https://env-newperion-premiumstg.kinsta.cloud/glossary/behavioral-targeting/): Online Behavioral Targeting \(OBA\) or Interest\-based Advertising creates a profile based on a consumer's past behavior, such as their engagement with content \(including ad clicks\) related to a specific brand or the number of pages visited on a particular topic\.
- [Awareness Campaign](https://env-newperion-premiumstg.kinsta.cloud/glossary/awareness-campaign/): An ad campaign that works with the goal of boosting brand visibility and recognition by educating potential customers about a brand\.
- [Broadcast Video on Demand \(BVOD\)](https://env-newperion-premiumstg.kinsta.cloud/glossary/broadcast-video-on-demand-bvod/): Streaming services provided by traditional TV broadcasters\.
- [Conversion Rate](https://env-newperion-premiumstg.kinsta.cloud/glossary/conversion-rate/): The percentage of users who interact with an ad and successfully complete an action, calculated by dividing the total number of conversions by the number of visitors to a website or media channel\.

Optimization
 
 
 
Leverage  performance, powered by precision.
Perion One optimizes in real time across every channel where modern media runs.
For advertisers, that means continuous reallocation of spend and pacing toward the placements driving incremental outcomes. For publishers, the same infrastructure routes demand, and protects yield on every impression.
 
 
 
 
 
 Explore Optimization 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Measurable Outcomes
 
 
 
Know what’s working and why. Perion One gives you full visibility into campaign performance — across every channel, every format, and every dollar spent. Marketers can prove impact, not just report it. Publishers can make smarter supply decisions and grow revenue predictably.

One partner. Every screen.
